reviewer: Codex — actual model visual inspection (not a human certification)
method: Manual model review of all 28 PT pairs for equivalent primary selling claims; generic computer identity is shared. No invented numeric overlap score. PT03 owns base configuration; display, context, task relationships, input, cooling and ports have distinct primary jobs. Shared computer imagery does not itself repeat a selling claim.

images.notes: Purchase reason: Eclipse Gray chassis and Aura Sync light bar; computer identity consistent with original source.
Home gaming context: actual computer composited onto an original empty desk; no included accessory implication.
Only full base configuration panel: Ryzen 9 8940HX, RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU, 16GB DDR5, 1TB NVMe, Windows 11 Pro.
Display panel: 16-inch, 1920x1200 IPS-level anti-glare, 165Hz, 100% sRGB; exact reference SKU supports these facts.
Task relationships explain CPU/GPU, GPU/memory and SSD/memory roles without repeating full base specification panel. Original abstract viewport is illustrative.
Original ordinary-touchpad keyboard crop on white. Leaders point to dedicated hotkeys, 4-zone keyboard and actual touchpad. No optional NumberPad claim.
Original rear vent photo supports cooling presentation; no invented performance percentage or thermal measurement.
Actual left/right port openings match leaders. Two USB4 Type-C, two USB-A, HDMI, LAN, power and audio; DisplayPort both Type-C, PD one. Wireless fact separately supported.
